blurb: A linear controller balances the pole while gliding the cart from side to side.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("CartPole-v1", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: ◀ ▶ push the cart left or right
manual.youSee: the cart's position and speed, the pole's angle and spin
manual.score: +1 for every step the pole stays up
manual.gameOver: the pole leans past 12°, the cart leaves the track, or 500 steps

blurb: Too weak to drive straight up: it pushes with its velocity to swing higher each time.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("MountainCar-v0", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: ◀ push left, coast, or ▶ push right
manual.youSee: the car's position along the track and its speed
manual.score: −1 for every step until the flag
manual.gameOver: the car reaches the flag on the right hilltop, or 200 steps

blurb: Energy pumping swings it up, then a PD controller catches it at the top.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("Pendulum-v1", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: a twist on the pivot, from −2 to 2
manual.youSee: which way the pendulum points (its angle's cosine and sine) and how fast it spins
manual.score: 0 at best: minus how far it is from upright, how fast it spins and how hard you twist
manual.gameOver: never early: 200 steps

blurb: Torque on the elbow, timed with the swing, lifts the tip over the line.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("Acrobot-v1", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: twist the joint between the links: −1, 0 or +1
manual.youSee: both joints' angles (cosine and sine) and how fast each turns
manual.score: −1 for every step until the tip is above the line
manual.gameOver: the tip swings above the line, or 500 steps

blurb: MuJoCo's cart-pole, held up for all 1,000 steps by Farama's SAC expert.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("InvertedPendulum-v5", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: push the cart, from −3 to 3
manual.youSee: the cart's position and speed, the pole's angle and spin
manual.score: +1 for every step the pole stays within 0.2 rad of upright
manual.gameOver: the pole leans past 0.2 rad, or 1,000 steps

blurb: Two poles stacked on a cart, both held upright by Farama's SAC expert.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("InvertedDoublePendulum-v5", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" }); // plus the showreel's default_camera_config

manual.controls: push the cart, from −1 to 1
manual.youSee: the cart's position, both poles' angles (sine and cosine), every speed, the force on the cart
manual.score: +10 for every step it stays up, less for a low tip and for spinning poles
manual.gameOver: the tip drops to 1 m (it stands 1.2 m tall), or 1,000 steps

blurb: Farama's SAC expert puts the fingertip on each new target.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("Reacher-v5", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: twist the two joints, each from −1 to 1
manual.youSee: the arm's angles and speeds, where the target is, and the gap from fingertip to target
manual.score: minus the fingertip's distance from the target, minus the effort
manual.gameOver: never early: 50 steps

blurb: A seven-joint arm, Farama's SAC expert, sweeps to the puck and pushes it into the goal.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("Pusher-v5", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" }); // plus the showreel's default_camera_config

manual.controls: seven twists, shoulder to wrist, each from −2 to 2
manual.youSee: the arm's angles and speeds, and where the fingertip, the puck and the goal are
manual.score: minus the puck's distance from the goal, half the fingertip's distance from the puck, and the effort
manual.gameOver: never early: 100 steps

blurb: Gymnasium's own heuristic lands between the flags.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("LunarLander-v3", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: fire the left engine, the main engine or the right engine, or do nothing
manual.youSee: position, speed, tilt and spin, and which legs touch the ground
manual.score: nearer, slower and level scores, +10 per leg down, firing costs points; +100 landed, −100 crashed
manual.gameOver: it crashes, flies off the screen, or comes to rest; 1,000 steps

blurb: Gymnasium's gait state machine walks the whole course.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("BipedalWalker-v3", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: four motors: both hips and both knees, each from −1 to 1
manual.youSee: the hull's tilt and speeds, each joint, which feet touch, and 10 lidar distances ahead
manual.score: about 300 for walking to the far end, minus torque and tilt; −100 for a fall
manual.gameOver: the hull hits the ground or the walker reaches the end; 1,600 steps

manual.score: about 300 for walking to the far end, minus torque and tilt; −100 for a fall

blurb: Pure pursuit on the track's centre line, braking into the bends.
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("CarRacing-v3", new { render_mode = "rgb_array" });

manual.controls: steer left or right, gas, brake
manual.youSee: a 96×96 colour picture from above: the car, the road and the gauges
manual.score: 1,000 shared among the road's tiles, each paid when first reached; −0.1 every frame
manual.gameOver: the lap is done (95% of the road), or the car leaves the playfield (−100); 1,000 steps

blurb: Farama's TQC expert at full gallop: 17,629 in a thousand steps.

manual.controls: six torques: thigh, shin and foot of each leg
manual.youSee: the body's height and pitch, every joint's angle, every speed
manual.score: forward speed, minus 0.1 × the torques squared
manual.gameOver: never early, not even upside down: 1,000 steps

blurb: One leg, hopping forward for all 1,000 steps (Farama's SAC expert).

manual.controls: three torques: thigh, leg and foot
manual.youSee: the torso's height and tilt, the joints' angles, every speed
manual.score: +1 for staying up, plus forward speed, minus the effort
manual.gameOver: it falls (the torso below 0.7 m or tilted past 0.2 rad); 1,000 steps

blurb: Two legs, running forward (Farama's SAC expert).
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("Walker2d-v5", new { render_mode = "rgb_array", camera_name = "track" });

manual.controls: six torques: thigh, leg and foot of each leg
manual.youSee: the torso's height and tilt, the joints' angles, every speed
manual.score: +1 for staying up, plus forward speed, minus the effort
manual.gameOver: it falls (the torso below 0.8 m or above 2 m, or tilted past 1 rad); 1,000 steps

blurb: Four legs, eight motors, running forward (Farama's SAC expert).
make: using IEnv env = Gymnasium.Make("Ant-v5", new { render_mode = "rgb_array", camera_name = "track" });

manual.controls: eight torques: hip and ankle of each of four legs
manual.youSee: the torso's height and orientation, the joints, every speed, the contact forces (105 numbers)
manual.score: +1 for staying healthy, plus forward speed, minus the effort and the contact forces
manual.gameOver: the torso leaves 0.2 to 1 m of height (a flip or a leap); 1,000 steps

blurb: Seventeen motors, a humanoid walking for all 1,000 steps (Farama's TQC expert, at three-quarter speed).

manual.controls: seventeen torques: abdomen, hips, knees, shoulders and elbows
manual.youSee: the body's pose and speeds, each part's mass and motion, the forces on it (348 numbers)
manual.score: +5 for staying up, plus 1.25 × forward speed, minus the effort and the impacts
manual.gameOver: the torso drops below 1 m or rises above 2 m; 1,000 steps

manual.controls: two torques, one for each joint
